title: SNI menu height doesn't take into account panels
line: Very long system tray menus and their submenus now fit between the top of the screen and the panel instead of running off the top.
explanation: On Wayland Qt doesn't know the screen area covered by panels, so QMenu sized a long tray menu to the full screen height. Anchored above the tray icon, the menu then started above the top edge, hiding its first entries; submenus did the same. The tray now caps the menu height to the screen area left free by panels, and submenus of application (DBusMenu) menus take the same cap, so they scroll instead.

commits.message:
applets/systemtray: keep long menus out of the panels

Qt doesn't know where the panels are on Wayland, so a long tray menu
was as tall as the whole screen and its first entries ended up above the
top edge. Limit the menu and its submenus to the space panels leave free.

BUG: 526183

media.caption: 83-entry tray menu: 'Top item' is above the screen edge and 'Proxies' is cut
Same menu: starts below the top edge and ends at the panel, scroll arrow at the bottom
80-entry 'Proxies' submenu: 'Proxy node 1' is off the top of the screen
Same submenu: 'Proxy node 1' visible, fits above the panel
With an 80 px panel the menu still fits above it

review.text: Capping QMenu maximumHeight in applets/systemtray and propagating it to DBusMenu submenus is a reasonable Plasma-side fix given the underlying QtWayland constraint-adjustment limitation, and the screenshots show long menus and submenus fitting above normal and thick panels. However, calling corona()->availableScreenRect(screen()).height() unchecked can dereference a null corona or pass 0 to QWidget::setMaximumHeight() whenever availableScreenRect() is empty (e.g., screen() == -1 or plasmoidviewer), collapsing the menu to zero height. Additionally, auto-hide and dodge-windows panels do not reduce availableScreenRect(), so long menus opened from those panels still overflow off-screen.
changes: Guard against a null corona() and non-positive maximumHeight in showSystemTrayMenuWayland() (only call menu->setMaximumHeight(maximumHeight) when maximumHeight > 0, otherwise reset to QWIDGETSIZE_MAX) so menus cannot collapse to 0 px if availableScreenRect() is empty.
Capture parentMenu via QPointer<QMenu> in PlasmaDBusMenuImporter::createMenu() instead of a raw pointer in the aboutToShow lambda.
Account for auto-hide / dodge-windows panels where availableScreenRect() equals the full screen height (or cap against screen height minus panel thickness when trayWindow is the panel itself).
